stories.title: Anti-CEC protests: Oppn, police face off again; Rahul says won’t stop till Gyanesh quits

en.title: Anti-CEC protests: Oppn, police face off again; Rahul says won't stop till Gyanesh quits
en.summary: Opposition parties from the INDIA bloc attempted to protest at Jantar Mantar demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, but were detained by Delhi Police before reaching the site. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge had organized a lunch meeting to plan the demonstration.

en.title: Children Among 28 Killed In Ukraine As Russia Intensifies Attacks
en.summary: Ukrainian authorities reported that 28 people, including children, were killed in intensified Russian attacks, with 20 deaths occurring in the Pryluky strike.

en.summary: Following a Bombay High Court hearing, one of three MPSC protests was withdrawn while two others continued.

en.summary: A building collapse in Delhi killed three people, including a pregnant woman and two children.

stories.title: Bombay High Court asks Maharashtra to restore trust of MPSC aspirants, students to return to classes

en.title: Bombay High Court asks Maharashtra to restore trust of MPSC aspirants, students to return to classes
en.summary: The Bombay High Court addressed concerns from civil service examination aspirants regarding thousands of unfilled government positions, procedural irregularities in exams, and leaked question papers. The court acknowledged that student protests reflect legitimate grievances requiring attention.

en.summary: During an INDIA Bloc protest, a bus transporting detained Congress leader Rahul Gandhi was punctured by Congress workers.

en.title: Two children among three killed as four-storey building collapses in Delhi's Seemapuri
en.summary: A four-storey building in North East Delhi's Seemapuri partially collapsed in the afternoon, resulting in three deaths including two children. Rescue operations are ongoing.

stories.title: Delhi building collapse: Pregnant woman, child among 3 killed in Seemapuri; 8 injured

en.title: Delhi building collapse: Pregnant woman, child among 3 killed in Seemapuri; 8 injured
en.summary: A building collapse in Delhi's Seemapuri area killed three people, including a child and a pregnant woman, while injuring eight others. The incident prompted emergency rescue operations and structural safety concerns.

stories.title: Foreign investors pull out $26.3 billion from emerging markets in September as hawkish Fed pushes US Treasury yields higher

en.title: Foreign investors pull out $26.3 billion from emerging markets in September as hawkish Fed pushes US Treasury yields higher
en.summary: Foreign investors withdrew $26.3 billion from emerging-market stocks and bonds in September, driven by rising US yields following the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance. This marked the first outflow since June, with particularly heavy selling pressure in South Korea affecting equity valuations.

stories.title: Iraq devalues its currency as Iran-US war disrupts oil shipping routes

en.title: Iraq devalues its currency as Iran-US war disrupts oil shipping routes
en.summary: Iraq's central bank devalued its currency to 1,500 dinars per US dollar from 1,300, following a cabinet meeting to address economic needs. Regional conflicts widened the gap between official and market exchange rates.

stories.title: Ola Electric board approves rights issue at 26% discount; shareholders to pay in two calls

en.title: Ola Electric board approves rights issue at 26% discount; shareholders to pay in two calls
en.summary: Ola Electric announced a rights issue at Rs 27 per share to raise up to Rs 1,000 crore, with investors paying 60% upfront and the remainder later. The funding aims to reduce debt and help achieve cash breakeven.

stories.title: Adani Enterprises gets rating upgrade from CARE Ratings to AA; Stable; shares up 21% in 2026

en.title: Adani Enterprises gets rating upgrade from CARE Ratings to AA; Stable; shares up 21% in 2026
en.summary: CARE Ratings upgraded Adani Enterprises to its highest credit rating, citing improved financial flexibility from a Rs 15,000 crore capital raise and airport stake sale.

stories.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq retreat from records as oil and Treasury yields rebound

en.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq retreat from records as oil and Treasury yields rebound
en.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq declined from recent record levels as Treasury yields and oil prices rose. Energy sector profits are forecast to increase significantly in the third quarter, while major chip stocks including Micron Technology and Nvidia experienced notable declines.
